product.title: Rock Springs 2-Hour Glass Bottom Guided Kayak Eco Tour

description.text: A good choice for nature lovers, this tour takes you into a unique part of Rock Springs Run known as "Emerald Cut.” The first part of the tour is an upstream paddle through calm waters and overhead tree canopy, with stops to hop off your clear kayak and into the fresh spring water. Keep your eyes peeled for for fish, turtles, birds, small alligators, and more.Clear kayak tour Local guide See wild animals in their natural habitat Kayak and safety gear provided Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
